lines.text: Life shows in whole points again with Charsi's Vitality ranks past the maximum
Baal's drops that don't fit your inventory go into your stash, not lost on CONTINUE
Grim Shield takes 2×3 cells, and Swirling Crystal and Dimensional Shard 1×3, as in D2
Gear you drop stays on the ground until you've walked well away from it, not picked straight back up
The Windows app no longer slows down over a long session: its graphics memory stays flat instead of growing until a restart
d2survivors.lol always opens on its own page now, returning players too: PLAY IN THE BROWSER takes you into the game
The desktop app tries again when the disk fails to read a game file for a moment, and one that keeps failing now says plainly what to try
The main menu is down to PLAY, OPTIONS and SAVES, with EXIT below, and WEBSITE, DISCORD and NEWS in its top right corner
WEBSITE opens d2survivors.lol, home of the credits, the legal notice and the desktop app's download, in place of CREDITS and GET THE DESKTOP APP
Charsi's upgrades are in the campfire's INVENTORY now, beside your hero's gear
The campfire's START sits on a stone the size of EXIT and INVENTORY, as in Diablo II
The setup warns that the hosted files are going away very soon: D2 Survivors will run only on your own Diablo II or D2R files
Act bosses no longer speed up as Faster Run/Walk does: in view they keep their own pace, so a quick hero can outrun them
A weapon's added fire, cold, lightning, magic and poison damage now hurts monsters immune to physical damage, as in Diablo II: Lightsabre's magic and lightning among them
A save code holding a rare Paladin shield now imports on another device, and the shield no longer drops out of the stash
On a phone, switching to another app and back no longer leaves the screen black: the game is drawn again as you left it, paused until you tap RETURN TO GAME
Monsters that flee (Howl, Terror, Hit Causes Monster to Flee) come back, as in Diablo II, instead of vanishing for good with their experience and drops
Monsters out of sight as an act's boss falls leave their experience gems too
Soon D2 Survivors will run only on your own Diablo II files: a note on the main menu says so once, with USE YOUR OWN FILES
SAVES on the main menu keeps your progress as a file or a code, and imports either one, on the website and in the desktop app
The Esc menu reads RESUME, OPTIONS, REPORT, SAVE AND EXIT, and Esc resumes
Options keeps the sound and music sliders on a SOUND OPTIONS page of their own
Portals, smiths and dropped loot no longer land inside a statue or a tree where you can't reach them
d2survivors.lol opens on a page of its own: what the game is, the desktop app and the news. The game is at d2survivors.lol/play/, where returning players go straight away
The website has a FAQ and its privacy and legal pages, in English and Korean, and Ko-fi tips that buy nothing in the game
Increased Speed and Burst of Speed follow D2's curve: a lot at first, then less, no longer a rocket with +skills
+Life and Life per Level on gear give twice as much, D2's share of your life
Deadly Strike rolls after a critical strike misses, as in D2, instead of adding to its chance
Magic Damage Reduced also takes its points off fire, cold and lightning hits, before your resistance
Faster Block Rate shortens a block as much as in D2
Life Stolen goes by the damage a monster takes: less from physically resistant ones, none from immunes
-% to Enemy Resistance lowers a monster's resistance, as in D2, instead of adding damage
Damage +N on The Redeemer and Astreon's Iron Ward now works
Open Wounds and Crushing Blow follow D2 on champions, uniques and past level 60
The mana globe counts Increase Maximum Mana on your own mana only, as D2 does
D2 Survivors has a Discord server: DISCORD on the main menu
Play with your own Diablo II on the website: pick its folder once, and the game reads its art and sound from this browser, with nothing to download
Diablo II: Resurrected works too: the website and the desktop app take its folder, with its own sounds and music. The desktop app copies your game files once more after this update
The game downloads less as you play, so its monsters and music come in sooner
On a slow connection a new act no longer freezes the run, and an act boss whose art comes late takes his real look instead of staying a white shape
Smite strikes as in D2: your sword's and your shield's damage together, at your shield bash's pace
The Amazon's Dodge, Avoid and Evade work as in D2: Dodge and Avoid while she stands still, Evade while she moves, never all three at once
Frozen Armor and Shiver Armor turn aside monsters' missiles too, as D2's Defense does
A fresh Nightmare or Hell run, started without the hero who beat Baal, is harder: its monsters are tougher and hit in full, and its act bosses stand longer
As an act's boss falls, the field falls with him, leaving only experience gems, and the portal opens a few strides from his loot
The act's blacksmith stands by the portal (Charsi, Fara, Hratli, Halbu): walk up to sell, buy, gamble and use the stash, the game held meanwhile
Baal's screen and the campfire say when your hero carries on into Nightmare or Hell, and a fresh start there says why it's level 1
A run starts as in D2, with only Attack and your starting weapon, and your first card comes at once: a first skill from each skill tree, so all six skill slots are yours to fill
Gear works at any level again: an item's Required Level is shown, but it no longer holds the item back
The death screen of a continued run counts its time from where it went on, the same clock as the best time beside it
Controller support: play a whole run and every menu with a gamepad, with D2R's layout, rumble, and its buttons rebound in Options
Going on to Nightmare or Hell straight after Baal no longer drops a frame
Patches of floor no longer turn black as you walk into a new area or act
EXIT on the main menu no longer freezes the game: the desktop app quits, and the website goes back to the title at once
Dexterity and every critical strike chance now say which hits can crit: weapon skills and some spells, as each skill's hover shows
The desktop app keeps your save on disk as you play: a saved run no longer comes back an act behind after the app closes, and the Esc menu says where CONTINUE starts again

The blue globe no longer shows experience: always full, it shows your hero's mana as D2 counts it, and its box says what mana does here. Experience fills the experience bar, as in D2, with its numbers when you point at it
CONTINUE on a run saved as an Act I began (a continued difficulty's, or one left through the cow portal) no longer fails to draw the screen while it loads
Report a bug, a balance note or an idea from the Esc menu, the death and victory screens or Options: your run, build and gear and a screenshot go with it
The developer's note no longer repeats the X handle above its X button

A Druid shifts only while the spells he has put more levels in than his Werewolf or Werebear recharge, and turns back as soon as one is ready, so a wereform picked late no longer stops his spells; the wereforms' cards say No spells in red
Dying after going on past Baal, or as the hero who beat him, shows the best time of such runs on that difficulty, no longer the fresh run's
The menu and the credits say plainly that this is an unofficial fan project
The campfire's START waits for a hero: pick one at the fire, then START (or Enter) begins the run
On the credits, the X button sits on the right, opposite EXIT
Louder at full volume: quiet areas no longer sound faint, and big fights still don't blast
A one-time note from the developer on the main menu: the game is still a beta, and where to find me on X
A fresh Nightmare or Hell run levels up faster again, so the gear you bring comes on within minutes
A gentler first minute: a handful of Fallen and Zombies, no Quill Rats or Shamans until 0:30 and then two at a time, Corpsefire at 0:55, and the full field by 2:00
Once a hero kills Baal, the menu starts her Nightmare (or Hell) as that hero, at her level, with her build and gear, as in D2
The credits no longer have a tip button: the game is entirely non-commercial
After Baal, opening Charsi's wares twice no longer hides your globes, skills and gold until you restart the game
Nature's Peace's Oak Sage no longer grows your life without end: its life and Battle Orders' are each a share of your own, added together as in D2
Nightmare and Hell shorten your chills, freezes, Terror, Dim Vision, Confuse and Attract on monsters to a half and a quarter, as D2 does, and no longer the monsters' chills and curses on you
Monsters resist each element by D2's numbers, and immunities break only as D2's do: Amplify Damage, Decrepify, Lower Resist and Conviction lower resistances, a fifth as much on an immune
Desktop app: the game's art loads sooner
Gear asks its D2 Required Level again: wear it at any level, but above yours it shows red and gives nothing until you reach it
Experience works as in D2: monsters well below your level give less, so you level close to them instead of racing far ahead
The stamina bar is drawn as D2 draws it: a flat gold over the panel's stone, turning red with under a quarter left
A run started on Nightmare or Hell has its skill and passive slots from the start: 8 and 8 on Nightmare, 10 and 10 in Hell
Champions' and uniques' chests give level-ups through Act II and now and then in Act III, then stat points or +1 to a skill tree: the build fills in Acts IV-V
A bigger stash, as in Resurrected: a 10×10 tab of your own for each hero and three shared ones (your old stash is the first)
Baal's last wave, the Minions of Destruction, no longer lasts until he falls: it comes as long as his other waves
A unique's minions no longer teleport or curse, and Nightmare's and Hell's monsters hit with D2's share of fire, cold and lightning
An act's portal waits for you: pick up the floor, then walk in (the monsters keep coming)
Nightmare and Hell experience gems look their worth, even to a hero far above the monsters
The run's gold visibly goes into Charsi's purse as the run ends, and at her wares after Baal
In Brave the hero and the world no longer vanish under a grey haze, and on older phones big sprites no longer draw as solid boxes
Quieter sound: the volume sliders turn down smoothly to silence, and big fights no longer blast
The first gear you can wear points you to the inventory, once
Korean speaks Diablo II: Resurrected's words, and much more of the game is in Korean
A run continued into Nightmare and Hell meets their full strength, and its act bosses stand longer
The game in Korean: pick it in Options, or a Korean browser picks it
Item boxes show D2's own text again, without the damage comparison
Desktop app: updates arrive within seconds, with a status line in the corner
The Druid's Raven, Oak Sage and shapeshifting grow with +skills past their maximum
Claws of Thunder, Iron Golem, Hurricane, Blade Shield and Shadow Master no longer deal less than the skills they replace
Meteor and Blizzard get their full synergies from the skills they evolved from
Stat-only level-ups no longer pause: spend the points on the character screen, or turn on Auto Stats
On a phone, items sell to Charsi: pick one up and tap Sell
+skills on gear raise passives and auras too
Evolved skills grow with +skills like the skills they replace
The character screen counts area damage
D2's lighting now shows: the dark acts are darker, and fires light them up
Chests glow and stand out in a crowd; act bosses drop D2's golden chest
Claw Vipers, Duriel and other chargers hit once per charge
Charsi sells ranks past the maximum, and imbues rares
After Baal, carry your hero on into Nightmare
Two more skill and passive slots each difficulty
Wirt's Leg stays in your inventory
The Secret Cow Level has a new way in
Nightmare and Hell runs level up at a steady pace
Barbarians and Assassins can wield a weapon in each hand
NEWS on the main menu: what changed, build by build
Rest a skill from its slot to stop casting it
Whirlwind and Leap now go where you steer
Smaller downloads, so each act loads sooner
Diablo II's uniques drop on the new bases
Skill slots and level-up cards read clearly
Tab opens the automap, plus a corner mini-map
Act IV runs smoothly on slower machines
Nightmare and Hell hit as hard as in Diablo II
New bases: crossbows, spears, polearms and more
One tab plays at a time, keeping your save safe
Save and Exit keeps your run; Continue picks it up
Closing the tab mid-run no longer loses its gold
Less lag when the screen fills with monsters
